# Flower Lifestyle

> Fresh, handcrafted floral arrangements and bouquets in Nairobi, Kenya.

We specialise in bespoke flowers for all occasions including birthdays, romance, anniversaries, and more.
We offer same-day delivery and deliver countrywide.

Location: City Market, Nairobi CBD

- Birthday
- Roses
- Romance

- Money Bouquet
